title: LOGSIS / AGC150 + ME96SS — Rede e gerador
description: Exclusivo para AGC150_REDE_GERADOR_ESSENCIAL_R1.bin. AGC150 MDB1–64, reserva MDB65–84, ME96SS independente MDB85–97. O multimedidor não representa a rede nem a carga do unifilar. Escalas informadas pelo usuário: tensão /10; FP /1000; corrente, potências e energia /1. Energia ME96SS composta como UINT32 por solicitação do usuário: HIGHER MDB97 × 65536 + LOWER MDB96, divisor 1. Banco configurável por Id_Logsis; datasource por DS_POSTGRES. Não modifica o Studio.

list.name: MM_Divisor_FP
list.label: ME96SS: divisor do fator de potência

list.label: ME96SS: base binária da palavra HIGHER

panels.description: ME96SS independente, slave 2, canais 85–97. Sem vínculo elétrico com o unifilar AGC150. Tensão /10; FP /1000; demais /1 conforme informado pelo usuário. Energia composta como UINT32: MDB97 HIGHER × 65536 + MDB96 LOWER, divisor 1, conforme solicitado. Representações INT16 negativas das palavras são normalizadas para unsigned antes da composição. Escalas e representação de P/Q/FP permanecem configuráveis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH readings AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."time",(CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END) = trunc((CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END)) AND (CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END) BETWEEN -2147483648 AND 4294967295) THEN (CASE WHEN mod(((CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END))::numeric+4294967296,4294967296)>=2147483648 THEN mod(((CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END))::numeric+4294967296,4294967296)-4294967296 ELSE mod(((CASE WHEN length(payload->>'mdb23')<32 AND payload->>'mdb23' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (payload->>'mdb23')::numeric END))::numeric+4294967296,4294967296) END) END)/1 AS v FROM ${Id_Logsis:raw} t
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT to_jsonb(t) AS payload) p WHERE t."time"<=$__timeTo()),
    prior AS (SELECT * FROM readings WHERE "time"<=$__timeFrom() AND v>=0 ORDER BY "time" DESC,v LIMIT 1),
    inside AS (SELECT * FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND v>=0),
    first_inside AS (SELECT * FROM inside ORDER BY "time",v LIMIT 1),
    base AS (SELECT * FROM prior WHERE v<=(SELECT v FROM first_inside)
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM first_inside WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prior WHERE v<=first_inside.v)),
    points AS (SELECT "time",min(v) AS v,count(DISTINCT v)>1 AS conflict FROM (
      SELECT * FROM inside UNION ALL SELECT * FROM base) p GROUP BY "time"),
    steps AS (SELECT *,lag(v) OVER(ORDER BY "time") AS prev FROM points),
    totals AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,bool_or(conflict) AS conflict,count(*) FILTER(WHERE v<prev) AS drops,
      (SELECT v FROM points ORDER BY "time" DESC LIMIT 1)-(SELECT v FROM base) AS delta FROM steps)
    SELECT CASE WHEN n>=2 AND delta>=0 AND NOT conflict THEN delta END AS "VALUE",
      CASE WHEN n<2 THEN 'SEM AMOSTRAS SUFICIENTES' WHEN conflict THEN 'AMOSTRAS CONFLITANTES'
      WHEN delta<0 THEN 'CONTADOR REINICIOU' WHEN drops>0 THEN 'QUEDA NO CONTADOR · PARCIAL'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prior WHERE v<=(SELECT v FROM first_inside)) THEN 'SEM BASE ANTERIOR · PARCIAL' ELSE 'OK' END AS "STATUS",
      CASE WHEN n>=2 AND delta>=0 AND NOT conflict THEN to_char(delta,'FM999999999990.00') || ' h' ||
        CASE WHEN drops>0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prior WHERE v<=(SELECT v FROM first_inside)) THEN ' *' ELSE '' END ELSE '—' END AS "EXIBICAO" FROM totals
